citation: JSON tuple of sourceKey and spanId
sellerKey: signed manifest public key; free results bind on verified free read
legacy: Missing source remains unresolved and retains original singleton semantics. No old entries, invoices, intent IDs, manifests or blobs are rewritten. New federation never guesses an origin for historical obligations.
recovery: Endpoint context is saved with the reservation, before signing. Removal disables new purchase admission; existing obligations retain the saved numeric loopback endpoint.
trust: Reputation remains keyed by seller wallet across origins.
receiptDispatch: v1 rejects source extensions, preserves legacy semantics and labels origin unresolved; v2 requires matching source fields and audited reservation context.
